en.name: AI, Built
en.playlist_title: AI, Built: How Modern AI Works, and How It Came to Be
en.playlist_description: A thirty-one-part course on how modern AI works and how it came to be, built from the ground up: information theory and the symbolic era; linear algebra, calculus and randomness; classical and statistical machine learning; neural networks, the deep learning revolution, optimization and scaling; attention, the language-model lineage, memory, sparsity, hardware, pretraining and inference; generative models, diffusion, images, video, every sense as tokens, self-supervised learning and AI for science; reinforcement learning from Bellman to AlphaZero, post-training, reasoning and agents; and what we find inside the models, and whether we can trust them. The thread through every part is Shannon's guessing game: what do you have to know, to guess well? Every derivation is on screen, and every number shown is computed and checked.
en.credits:
Animations: Manim Community Edition.
Narration: Qwen3-TTS (synthetic text-to-speech voices; the English voice is cloned from Kokoro-82M's af_heart).
Visual style inspired by 3Blue1Brown.
en.computed: Every number on screen is computed and checked; the pictures marked schematic, and the examples marked illustrative, are the exceptions.

zh.name: 人工智能，从零搭建
zh.playlist_title: 人工智能，从零搭建 | AI, Built
zh.playlist_description: 三十一集系列，从零讲清现代人工智能怎样工作、又是怎样一步步走到今天：信息论与符号主义时代；线性代数、微积分与随机性；经典与统计机器学习；神经网络、深度学习革命、优化与规模；注意力、语言模型的谱系、记忆、稀疏性、硬件、预训练与推断；生成模型、扩散、图像与视频、把每一种感官变成词元、自监督学习与科学中的人工智能；从贝尔曼方程到AlphaZero的强化学习、后训练、推理与智能体；以及打开模型后我们看到的东西，和我们能否信任它。贯穿每一集的主线是香农的猜字游戏：要猜得好，你得知道些什么？每一步推导都在屏幕上完成，画面上的每一个数字都经过计算和核对。中文配音、中文字幕，原创动画。

ai1.summary_en: Part 1 of a thirty-one-part series on how modern AI works and how it came to be. In 1951 Claude Shannon asked people to guess the next letter of English text; today every large language model is trained to play the same game. We build the mathematics of guessing from scratch: probability and the chain rule, the one sensible measure of surprise, entropy, prefix codes, Kraft's inequality and Huffman's algorithm, cross-entropy and the Kullback–Leibler divergence (and why it isn't symmetric), arithmetic coding, and why predicting and compressing are the same thing. We learn by counting on thirty novels, watch counting models fail to generalize, replay Shannon's experiment, and derive the gradient that trains every language model. Then we keep score on a page of The Maltese Falcon, which entered the public domain in 2026: from 8 bits per character as plain text, to 2.3 for counting, to 0.87 for Qwen3.
ai1.summary_zh: 三十一集系列的第1部分：现代人工智能如何运作、又如何走到今天。1951年，克劳德·香农请人猜英语文本的下一个字母；今天，每一个大语言模型都被训练去玩同一个游戏。我们从零搭建“猜”的数学：概率与链式法则、唯一合理的意外度、熵、前缀码、克拉夫特不等式与霍夫曼编码、交叉熵与KL散度（以及它为什么不对称）、算术编码，以及为什么预测与压缩是同一件事。我们在30部小说上用计数来学习，看计数模型如何无法泛化，重演香农的实验，并推导出训练每个语言模型的那个梯度。最后，在2026年进入公有领域的《马耳他之鹰》的一页上记分：纯文本每字符8比特，计数模型2.3比特，Qwen3只要0.87比特。
